name: Kamikawa (Saitama, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kamikawa town emblem in navy: a disc pierced by a stylised letter K in white.
history: Municipal flag of Kamikawa, a town in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 20 December 2006.

features.role: Kamikawa town emblem — a disc pierced by a stylised letter K in white
